tasks.task: Build a 90-day local marketing plan

items.when: For a new local client, or an owner who says they do not know what is working
When the owner wants everything at once, to cut the plan to one goal for the quarter
When the channel choice is open, to compare them all and shortlist small tests
When the plan only chases new customers and ignores job size and repeat visits
Before the 90 days are fixed, to compare two plans that put the owner's money and hours in different places

tasks.task: Audit a Google Business Profile against local rivals

items.when: When you need the profile checked against Google's guidelines and three nearby rivals
When you want a second ranked fix list and where name, address and phone differ
When you need each rival's site, prices and pitch gathered before comparing
When the business is missing from directories that matter and needs listing text

tasks.task: Write the profile description, services and first posts

items.when: When the owner has supplied the facts and the profile text must fit Google's limits
When the opening line sounds like every rival, to get three versions to choose from
When a line is vague, to test it and get a true, picturable rewrite

tasks.task: Write service and area pages

items.when: When one main service, or a service in one area, needs a page built from real local facts
When the page must also turn visitors into calls with proof and answers to doubts
When the page opening is weak, to get five headlines with a pick
When the page should show prices and you must decide how and where
When customers ask the same things by phone and the page should answer them
When the page is drafted, to find and fix its weakest parts
Before each page is written, to confirm the service is offered in that area at the price shown

tasks.task: Set up an honest review request habit

items.when: When you need the spoken ask, the follow-up message and the counter or van card
When every customer should be asked the same way, with no rewards or filters
When the owner is unsure of the best moment to ask and how to word it

tasks.task: Reply to a batch of Google reviews

items.when: When a batch of reviews needs specific, human replies, including the hard ones
When you need reply templates by review type that staff can reuse
Before replying, to see the real reason behind each review
Before a reply to a complaint is posted, to check each promise and the tone
When the batch is large, to check every reply and flag repeat complaints

tasks.task: Follow up quotes already sent

items.when: When a quote has gone quiet, to find why and get calm replies and easy-yes questions
When new enquiries wait, to qualify each and draft a reply the owner sends
When the follow-up is written, to try several subject lines
Before sending, to score the message and cut what drags

tasks.task: Build a 12-month seasonal offer calendar

items.when: When you know the busy and quiet months and need the job and offer for each season
Six to eight weeks before a marked season, or when the diary shows gaps
When one season's push needs a brief and a weekly calendar others can follow
When the season needs an offer that is not a price cut

tasks.task: Fill a quiet week with an offer that still pays

items.when: When the diary has gaps in the next two to six weeks and the offer must not lose money
When you want a gift or bundle idea to set beside a plain discount
Before the offer goes out, to find the deepest discount the margin allows
When the offer is drafted, to score it and get three changes to test first
When the offer goes to past customers by text and needs consent rules built in
When the offer is a thin discount and needs more value at the same cost
Before the offer goes out, to confirm the booking page shows open slots that week at the offer price

tasks.task: Check Local Services Ads and small local ads

items.when: Before switching on Local Services Ads, or when their leads feel dear or poor
When the owner wants to try search ads, to plan one small test with costs and rules
When the owner boosts an offer nearby and needs ad text and hooks to test

tasks.task: Set up lead tracking the owner will keep up

items.when: When the owner cannot say which channel books jobs or what a booked job costs
When profile, ad and post links need tags so visits can be told apart
When leads sit in a CRM, to see if the source field is good enough to trust

tasks.task: Run the weekly local routine

items.when: Each week in 15 to 30 minutes of the owner's time, plus a longer monthly check
When this week's posts should follow what worked last week
In the monthly check, to turn the numbers into trends, wins and what to change

tasks.task: Plan a month of local posts and job photos

items.when: When the owner does not know what to post, to find three to five subjects they know first-hand
When you need a rolling calendar with captions in the owner's voice
When a short video needs an opening, to get ten hooks with a first shot
When staff will make the post graphics themselves from a template

tasks.task: Design a trial or intro offer for first-timers

items.when: When you must choose between a free, discounted or premium first step
When the intro offer needs framing, a name, a guarantee and terms
When nervous first-timers need a promise the business can afford to keep
When the offer is drafted, to score it and get three changes to test
When people must try the service before they believe in it

tasks.task: Write a service menu or class descriptions

items.when: Before writing, to choose the one want each service should lead with
When the menu shows prices and add-ons and you must decide how
When a service line is flat, to get three versions to pick from
When a description could be any salon or studio, to get a true, picturable line
Before the menu is printed or posted, to trace each price, length and inclusion to the owner's list

tasks.task: Write reminder, rebooking and aftercare messages

items.when: When reminders and rebooking nudges go by text or WhatsApp
When the booking flow itself needs prep notes and a follow-up after the visit
When no-shows are the problem and you need the pattern before writing reminders
Before texts go live, to check cost, length and the rules they must meet
Before reminders and rebooking messages are sent, to confirm the booking link works on a phone

tasks.task: Win back lapsed clients and members

items.when: When you have a client list, to see who was worth most before you write to anyone
When you know the usual gap between visits and need messages timed to it
When the first message is drafted, to try several openings
Before the run starts, to score each message and fix the weak one

tasks.task: Write a new-client welcome pack

items.when: When a new client needs the first steps, what to bring and what happens next
When the pack should answer the questions every new client asks
When the pack is drafted, to read it as a new client and list what is unclear

tasks.task: Plan a loyalty perk, challenge or referral scheme

items.when: When regulars deserve perks that are not discounts, with a small test first
When happy clients should bring a friend and you need the reward and the flow

tasks.task: Write a local newsletter

items.when: When the business has news and customer questions and needs one useful issue
When the issue is drafted, to compare subject lines
Before the send, to get cuts, a score and a ship or fix verdict

tasks.task: Promote an open day or local event

items.when: When the owner wants to try an event, to plan it as a small test with costs
When the event needs a poster for the window and the notice board
When the event line is flat, to get five short headlines
When a nearby business or club could share the event and the audience
Before promoting, to confirm the date, place and sign-up link are right and still open

tasks.task: Launch a box scheme or membership

items.when: When you have price, margin and cash and need the offer worked out
When the launch needs the offer, billing emails and a way to keep people
When a studio or shop needs tier prices and reasons to move up
Before launch, to test that the scheme pays back in time

tasks.task: Write the business story and About page

items.when: When the owner can tell how and why they started and the page should sound human
When the opening line is forgettable, to get three versions
When the story is full of general claims, to get lines a reader can picture

tasks.task: Plan flyers, door drops and local print ads

items.when: When the owner wants print or local radio, to plan one small test with decision rules
When the flyer needs a headline, an offer and one clear call to action
When the main line is flat, to get five headlines that each take a new angle
When the piece is a mailer, to review the envelope line, offer, copy and look

always.when: Before the first job for an owner, to turn their own messages into voice rules
When copy states a number, an award or a guarantee you cannot trace to the owner
Before anything is printed or posted, to catch typos and names spelt two ways

helpers.when: When local rankings depend on site structure, technical fixes or a content plan
When search ads or Local Services Ads need building and managing, not only checking
When a fake review wave or a public dispute needs a case built for the platform
When service pages need designing and building, not only writing
When flyers, van signs or counter cards must be laid out for print
When the owner wants posting, replies and community run week to week

No library item writes service, treatment or class descriptions, or lays out a service menu with prices
No library item writes appointment reminder, rebooking, no-show or aftercare messages
No library item writes a follow-up run for a trade quote that has gone unanswered
No library item builds a trial offer pack for a gym or studio, or plans a member challenge
No library item gives before and after job post templates or a photo checklist for technicians
No library item covers Local Services Ads or a small search campaign for one service area; only the kit prompt does
No library item sets up call tracking or a front-desk lead source sheet; only the kit does
No library item plans a door drop or flyer run: streets, quantity, cost and the response needed to pay back
No library item writes an area page from real local facts while avoiding thin copies
No library item writes a new-client welcome pack with rules, for example for a groomer or kennel
No library item builds an open day pack or a seasonal what-is-ready calendar for a farm shop
No library item drafts two differently toned replies to one hard review for the owner to choose between
